title: Compatible affine exterior-to-self-Tor comparisons
statement: Let i:Z \to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] and n a natural number. Put E=\Lambda^n(i^*ker(i)) [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-pc-module-pullback], B=i_*O_Z and Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0] \otimes^{L} B[0]) in the fixed derived category [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For affine U in Y, let O_U=i^{-1}U and let T_U sheafify an A=Gamma(Y,U)-module on U, extend it to Y and tensor-pull it back to Z. Let c_U be the normalized exterior-conormal-to-Tor comparison for I=i.ker.ideal U [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. There is a family of local morphisms phi_U:E|_{O_U} \to Q|_{O_U}. Each admits coordinate isomorphisms s_U:E|_{O_U} \cong T_U(source(c_U))|_{O_U} and t_U:T_U(target(c_U))|_{O_U} \cong Q|_{O_U} such that phi_U=s_U followed by T_U(c_U)|_{O_U} followed by t_U. For every open W of Z and arrows W \to O_U and W \to O_{U'}, the components of phi_U and phi_{U'} on W are equal. No global morphism, dual square, or regularity is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 23.6.12, canonical resolution-independent Tor products; Tag 01R3 (1),(2) for conormal sections, Tag 06YH and its preceding K-flat resolution construction for derived tensor. Affine sheafification and localization implement steps 1-3 of new-r4-self-tor-conormal-dual-chart-iso.

proof.text: Apply exists_nested_affine_selfTor_coordinates and define φ_U by the threefold composite of its source coordinate, functorial algebraic comparison and target coordinate. This directly supplies IsAffineSelfTorChartMap on every U.

The affine associated module restricted along the chart is quasi-coherent. Identify tensor pullback with ordinary pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints. Restricting its open direct image to the inverse-image chart is, by pullback composition and the open-restriction counit, the pullback of that quasi-coherent chart module. Thus the affine model is quasi-coherent on the inverse-image chart. The supplied source coordinate transports quasi-coherence to E on that chart; no global exterior permanence lemma is needed. Transport along overEquiv and apply the proved source-library hom_ext_of_isAffine. Naturality along the isomorphism from the image of the top open to the terminal over-object transfers the hypothesis. This proves that equality on the whole affine inverse-image chart detects equality of morphisms from E, with no quasi-coherence assumption on the target.

For V⊆U restrict φ_U to Over(i^-1 V) by composing each over-arrow with the inclusion. The nested top-component equation and affine source extensionality identify this restricted map with φ_V. Extracting any component now gives equality on all subopens of i^-1 V.

Given arbitrary U,U′ and W mapping into both inverse-image charts, use the sieve of subopens L⊆W contained in i^-1 V for an affine V⊆U∩U′. It covers W: for each z∈W choose an affine neighborhood of i(z) in U∩U′ and intersect its inverse image with W. Naturality restricts the two images of each section to L; nested compatibility identifies each with the image under φ_V. The sheaf separatedness of Q then identifies them on W. Module hom extensionality gives the required component-map equality. This needs no affineness or quasi-compactness of U∩U′ or W.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compatible_affine_selfTor_maps
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n
    ∃ φ : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⟶ Q.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      (∀ U, IsAffineSelfTorChartMap i U n E Q (φ U)) ∧
      ∀ (U U' : Y.affineOpens) (W : Z.Opens)
        (a : W ⟶ i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (b : W ⟶ i ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1),
        (φ U).val.app (op (Over.mk a)) =
          (φ U').val.app (op (Over.mk b))
